questions.question_text: In machine learning, what does the term 'overfitting' describe?
options: When a model performs well on training data but fails to generalize to new, unseen data
When a model is too simple to learn the underlying pattern
When a computer has too much memory
When an algorithm processes data too quickly
questions.explanation: Overfitting occurs when a model captures 'noise' in the training data rather than the actual signal, leading to poor performance on test data.

questions.question_text: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing data packets between different networks?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer (Layer 3) handles logical addressing and routing, allowing data to travel across interconnected networks.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a type of supervised machine learning algorithm?
questions.explanation: Linear regression is a supervised learning algorithm used to predict a continuous outcome based on labeled training data.

questions.question_text: What is the primary function of a 'Neural Network' hidden layer?
options: Performing intermediate computations and feature transformations
Storing the long-term history of user interactions
questions.explanation: Hidden layers perform non-linear transformations on inputs to extract features that help the network solve complex problems.

questions.question_text: In the context of database management, what does ACID stand for?
questions.explanation: ACID is a set of properties that guarantee database transactions are processed reliably.

questions.question_text: Which search algorithm explores the tree level by level?
questions.explanation: BFS traverses a graph or tree by visiting all neighbors at the current depth before moving to nodes at the next depth level.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a 'Compiler'?
options: To interpret code line-by-line during runtime
To translate high-level source code into machine-executable code
To store data in a non-volatile format
To connect the CPU to the memory units
questions.explanation: A compiler converts entire programs into machine code before execution, whereas an interpreter performs this line-by-line.

questions.question_text: Which of these is NOT a principle of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)?
questions.explanation: The four main pillars of OOP are Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, and Abstraction. Compilation is a general computer science process.

questions.question_text: What is the main advantage of cloud computing?
options: Lower barrier to entry for scaling resources on-demand
Elimination of the need for internet access
questions.explanation: Cloud computing allows users to scale computational resources up or down quickly without needing to manage physical server hardware.

questions.question_text: In Big O notation, what does O(n) represent?
questions.explanation: O(n) indicates that the execution time grows directly in proportion to the size of the input.
